viewport_notes: blog listing: post cards in a consistent grid; featured images present; mobile single-column.

checks.rule: no spacing collisions/overlap; nothing wraps or overflows the viewport; typography cascade intact
no missing-image placeholders, no Liquid errors, no empty shells, no Lorem/[CLAIM] text, no draft/0-post void
post cards share one layout — image ratio, title size, excerpt length, meta all consistent (no jagged grid)
blog title is the H1; post titles are clearly the primary tap target on each card
featured images keep their subject at every viewport (no blank/subject-less mobile crop)
intentional editorial design per the niche scorecard, not a default Dawn blog list
